title: "What Should I Do?" Guidelines for Responsibly Integrating AI in Software Engineering
abstract: arXiv:2611.28996v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Speculations abound about the "right" ways for developers to integrate AI into their software engineering (SE) work, but the evidence that exists is sparse and contradictory. Yet, developers are held responsible for the products they ship with (or without) AI's help, so they need to integrate AI in responsible ways. To address this gap, we conducted a two-phase, large-scale investigation with 1,118 developers at Microsoft, GitHub, and Pfizer. In Phase 1, we surveyed 860 developers at Microsoft on where they sought and resisted AI support in their daily work, and from their accounts, synthesized 35 developer-facing guidelines: 29 across five categories of SE work and 6 cross-cutting ones. A year later, as AI capabilities and developers' experiences co-evolved, we validated them in Phase 2 with 258 developers in technology (Microsoft, GitHub) and biopharmaceutical (Pfizer) domains. translated_title: 《“我该怎么做？”在软件工程中负责任地集成人工智能的指南》
translated_abstract: 关于开发者将人工智能（AI）集成到软件工程（SE）工作中的“正确”方式，目前存在诸多猜测，但现有证据稀少且相互矛盾。然而，开发者需要对其（无论是否借助AI帮助）发布的产品负责，因此他们必须以负责任的方式集成AI。为填补这一空白，我们对微软、GitHub和辉瑞的1118名开发者开展了两阶段的大规模研究。在第一阶段，我们调查了微软的860名开发者，了解他们在日常工作中在哪些环节寻求AI支持、在哪些环节抗拒AI支持，并根据其反馈总结出35条面向开发者的指南：其中29条涵盖软件工程工作的五大类别，另有6条为跨领域通用指南。一年后，随着AI能力与开发者经验的共同演进，我们在第二阶段对来自科技领域（微软、GitHub）和生物医药领域（辉瑞）的258名开发者对这些指南进行了验证。研究中的开发者认为这些指南表述清晰（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该研究通过对微软、GitHub和辉瑞1118名开发者的两阶段大规模调查，总结出35条帮助开发者在软件工程工作中负责任地集成AI的实用指南，并在一年后跨行业验证了其有效性。
en_tdlr: This study synthesized 35 practical guidelines for responsibly integrating AI into software engineering work through a two-phase investigation of 1,118 developers at Microsoft, GitHub, and Pfizer, validating them across industries a year later.
